shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark on the vertical axis on the left with the mark at 5 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed function has no value at x=0. Right image: The displayed set includes 5 at its lower bound.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=0. On the right, the filled endpoint marks an inclusive boundary of the marked ray.
